message.content:
This is an LED status light assembly designed for use in a dental milling machine. The main candidates are:

- 8513 or 9405 (lighting)
- 8531.20 (indicator panels incorporating LEDs)
- 8543 (electrical machines with individual functions)
- 8466.93 or 8466.94 (parts of machine tools)
- 8487 or 8548

Heading 8531 covers electric sound or visual signaling apparatus, and 8531.20 covers indicator panels incorporating LEDs. The 8531.20.00 subheading is a close fit for a status indicator bar made of LEDs on a PCB. Alternatively, 8531.90 covers parts of such apparatus, but this item is a complete assembly that signals status, so 8531.20 fits better.

The HTSUS statistical suffix for 8531.20 is 8531.20.0040, "Indicator panels incorporating LCDs or LEDs: Other". The 8531.20.00 line splits into 8531.20.0020 for flat panel displays and 8531.20.0040 for other. I am choosing 8531.20.0040.

I recall a CBP ruling on this fastmill.io F2 LED assembly that classified it in 8531.20.0040. That recollection supports the choice.

{"hts_code": "8531.20.0040", "reason": "The LED status bar assembly is a visual signaling indicator incorporating LEDs that displays machine status, so it falls in heading 8531 as an LED indicator panel, not a flat panel display."}
